units.title: A signed Gaussian expectation
units.statement: For \(n\ge3\), \(\kappa\ge4\) and \(\ell\ge0\), the bounded radial Gaussian test has absolutely integrable expectations. Its signed Haar average is computed below.
assumptions: Exactly \(n\ge3\), \(\kappa\ge4\) and \(\ell\ge0\); the endpoint \(\ell=0\) is included.
\(O\) ranges over the full real orthogonal group, with its normalized Borel Haar probability \(\mu\), including both determinant signs.
\(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\) is the canonical Gaussian measure; \(dx\) is Euclidean volume and \(\|x\|_2\) is the true Euclidean norm.

The proof establishes \(t_\ell\in L^1(\gamma_O)\), \(t_\ell p_O\in L^1(dx)\), and \(\int t_\ell\,d\gamma_O=\int t_\ell p_O\,dx\) for every \(O\). It also proves absolute Haar integrability of \(O\mapsto\det(O)\int t_\ell\,d\gamma_O\). These are conclusions, with no extra integrability premise.
Dimension-half powers use real division. Positivity, density measurability and the law-to-density identity are proved internally.

steps.title: Bound the test
steps.text: Continuity and \(0<t_\ell\le1\) give absolute integrability under every Gaussian probability measure. This also covers \(\ell=0\).
steps.lean: The proof uses actual multivariateGaussian probability, continuity and an explicit norm bound; Gaussian test integrability is produced internally.

steps.title: Identify the density
steps.text: The existing density theorem identifies the actual law \(\gamma_O\) with the nonnegative, measurable density \(p_O\) relative to Euclidean volume. All source conditions are unchanged.
steps.lean: The proof actually calls GaussianLawDensity.gaussian_law_eq_density hn hκ O. Positivity and measurability are verified for the unchanged explicit p_O; no substitute Gaussian constructor is introduced.

steps.title: Transport the integral
steps.text: Transport absolute integrability and the expectation through that density identity. Both spatial integrals below are absolutely integrable.
steps.lean: The proof uses integrable_withDensity_iff and integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul, with internal measurable/finite/nonnegative density proofs. ENNReal.ofReal and multiplication order are simplified exactly.

steps.title: Control the outer expectation
steps.text: The compiled Fubini result gives joint integrability under \(\mu\otimes dx\). Integrating the spatial variable and using the pointwise identity gives absolute Haar integrability of the signed expectation.
steps.lean: The proof consumes the exact literal_mixture_transform joint-L1 conclusion and actual Integrable.integral_prod_left, then pointwise congruence and integral_const_mul. No unproved family-measurability premise is supplied.

steps.title: Apply the evaluated transform
steps.text: The pointwise density identity turns \(H_\gamma\) into the literal transform \(H_{\mathrm{lit}}\). Apply its already evaluated formula. The relation to conditioned mixtures and total variation is a later step.
steps.lean: The final composition uses the same pointwise expectation transport and exact equality projection of MixtureFubini.literal_mixture_transform hn hκ hℓ. No Gaussian/B6/Fubini proof is copied, and no TV or Poisson conclusion is asserted.
